resources.string: Adventure together in the same world
Everyone plays their own copy of the same Pokémon game. You see each other walking on the map, and when you meet, walk up and press A to trade or battle right there.
Your friends need the same game (for example Crystal with Crystal, or Gold with Silver). Up to 8 players.
Add a Pokémon Gold, Silver, Crystal, Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed or LeafGreen game to your library first.
Play multiplayer games with friends over the internet, or link Game Boy, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance games to trade and battle. Each player needs their own copy of the game.
Add the address of your room server to start playing online.
App version %1$s · link %2$s. To trade and battle, both players need the same version.
No public rooms right now. Host one and share the code with friends.
Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Add Game Boy Advance games to your library first.
Anyone can see and join it. Turn off to share the code only with friends.
Room codes have 6 letters and numbers.
Room not found. Check the code and try again.
Pick your copy of the game. For trades between different games, everyone needs a game that supports this link type.
Could not send the report. Try again later.
Close the game that is running first.
Trade and battle at the Cable Club. Works across Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed, LeafGreen and ROM hacks.
Union Room in FireRed, LeafGreen and Emerald. Up to 5 players.
Let the emulator pick. Use only when everyone plays the same game.
Multiplayer battles for up to 4 players.
Game Boy and Game Boy Color games link 2 at a time, like a real cable. Gold, Silver and Crystal trade with Red, Blue and Yellow through the Time Capsule.
Add Game Boy, Game Boy Color or Game Boy Advance games to your library first.
Add Game Boy or Game Boy Color games to your library first.
Not linked yet · Tap here and pick who to link with
Linked with %1$s · Walk up to them and press A

Connection dropped · Reconnecting, keep the game open
Waiting for a friend · Tap here to invite
Invite a friend: tap Invite and send them the code.
Link up. With 2 players this happens by itself; with more, tap Link next to a player.
Both players: go upstairs in any Pokémon Center and talk to the receptionist. The game asks you to save first.
Meet on the map: the list below shows where everyone is.
Walk up to them and press A, then pick Trade or Battle.
Both players: open the link or multiplayer option in your game.
Pick Trade or Battle (Colosseum) and have fun.
Accept to join your games as if by a link cable, so you can trade and battle.

Multiplayer on one game, like sharing a console: NES, SNES, Sega, PC Engine, Atari, N64, PlayStation and arcade.
Up to 8 players link their own Game Boy, Game Boy Color or Game Boy Advance games, as with link cables.
Add NES, SNES, Sega, N64, PlayStation or arcade games to your library first.
You need a %1$s game for this room.

Rooms stay open while anyone is in them, and for 5 minutes after the last player leaves.
